_comment: Drift-induced sibling of spot_prices.json, added 2026-08-30 per HarmonE.pdf §4.2-4.3. This dataset is Mode A (one CSV, split by train_frac at read time) so data_path points at the FULL drift-injected file produced by managed_system_regression/utility/drift/induce.py (--dataset spot_prices) — its training-portion rows are byte-identical copies of the original, so train_split() is unaffected; only stream() sees the induced drift. weights_path entries are intentionally IDENTICAL to spot_prices.json's so training happens once and is reused here. spot_prices.json itself is untouched, still pointing at the clean CSV — needed e.g. by experiments/calibrate_drift_threshold.py for a genuinely undrifted null distribution. Run induce.py to generate spot_prices_driftInduced.csv before using this config — nothing creates it automatically. ERCOT day-ahead prices 2019-2022; structural break already present at ~2021-02-13 (Winter Storm Uri) even before any induced drift — see docs/datasets/spot_prices.md.
